# ADOBE Lessons

> > Comprehensive tutorials and techniques for Adobe Creative Cloud applications including Photoshop, After Effects, Premiere Pro, InDesign, Lightroom, and Dimension CC.

ADOBE Lessons provides practical video tutorials and written guides covering photo editing, visual effects, motion graphics, color grading, and design workflows. The site features content from creators like Unmesh Dinda and PhenomenalVFX, focusing on both beginner fundamentals and advanced techniques for Adobe's creative software suite.

## Key Topics

- Photoshop CC
- After Effects CC
- Adobe Creative Cloud
- Visual Effects (VFX)
- Motion Graphics
- Photo Editing
- Color Grading
- Rotoscoping
- Premiere Pro
- InDesign
- Lightroom
- Keyboard Shortcuts
- Blend Modes
- Video Effects
- Design Workflows

## Photoshop Fundamentals & Techniques

- [Photoshop basics for beginners | Adobe Photoshop CC tutorials | Tour the work area](https://adobelessons.com/photoshop-basics-for-beginners-adobe-photoshop-cc-tutorials-tour-the-work-area): Beginner guide to Photoshop CC workspace and interface basics
- [2 Speed Tricks with 2 Keys in Photoshop + BONUS Trick?](https://adobelessons.com/2-speed-tricks-with-2-keys-in-photoshop-bonus-trick): Photoshop keyboard shortcuts using Shift and Alt/Option keys for sliders
- [Crop and straighten an image | Adobe Photoshop CC tutorials](https://adobelessons.com/crop-and-straighten-an-image-adobe-photoshop-cc-tutorials): Basic image cropping and straightening tutorial for Photoshop CC
- [Turn White into Any Color in Photoshop (Even Black!)](https://adobelessons.com/turn-white-into-any-color-in-photoshop-even-black): Color manipulation using Blend Modes and Blend-If in Photoshop
- [Lightroom to Photoshop | Adobe Photoshop CC tutorials | Add text to a photo in Photoshop](https://adobelessons.com/lightroom-to-photoshop-adobe-photoshop-cc-tutorials-add-text-to-a-photo-in-photoshop): Transfer photos from Lightroom to Photoshop and add text overlays

## Photo Editing & Color Grading

- [1-Minute Photoshop – Orange & Teal Look Made Easy](https://adobelessons.com/1-minute-photoshop-orange-teal-look-made-easy): Quick orange and teal color grading using Gradient Maps in Photoshop
- [Magically REMOVE SWEAT SPOTS in Photoshop!](https://adobelessons.com/magically-remove-sweat-spots-in-photoshop): Photo retouching tutorial for removing sweat spots using Hue/Saturation

## After Effects Visual Effects & Motion Graphics

- [Rotoscoping | After Effects CC Tutorial](https://adobelessons.com/rotoscoping-after-effects-cc-tutorial): After Effects rotoscoping tutorial using Roto-brush tool by PhenomenalVFX
- [5 Easy Title Motion Graphics Techniques | After Effects Tutorial](https://adobelessons.com/5-easy-title-motion-graphics-techniques-after-effects-tutorial): Five title animation techniques for motion graphics in After Effects
- [X-Men Super Speed | After Effects CC Tutorial](https://adobelessons.com/x-men-super-speed-after-effects-cc-tutorial): Create Quicksilver super speed effect from X-Men in After Effects
- [Throw a MOON Like Thanos – After Effects Tutorial](https://adobelessons.com/throw-a-moon-like-thanos-after-effects-tutorial): Recreate Thanos moon throw VFX from Avengers Infinity War
- [Digital Code Intro using STARDUST- After Effects Tutorial](https://adobelessons.com/digital-code-intro-using-stardust-after-effects-tutorial): Create digital code animation using Stardust plugin in After Effects
- [Top 5 After Effects Scripts to SPEED UP your Workflow 2018 NEW! – After Effects Tutorial](https://adobelessons.com/top-5-after-effects-scripts-to-speed-up-your-workflow-2018-new-after-effects-tutorial): Top productivity scripts for After Effects workflow optimization in 2018

- [How to Make a VHS Glitch in Premiere Pro | Adobe Creative Cloud](https://adobelessons.com/how-to-make-a-vhs-glitch-in-premiere-pro-adobe-creative-cloud): Create retro VHS glitch effects using adjustment layers in Premiere Pro
